visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair and glasses wearing a white t-shirt sits in a room with a laptop on a desk. He holds a package wrapped in white bubble wrap against a background of wooden cabinets with white panels. (2) He unwraps the package to reveal a thick dark blue book with the title 'Students' Practical Bilingual English-Chinese Dictionary' prominently displayed in yellow and red text. (3) A woman in a black tank top stands behind him as he opens the book to show that the interior is hollow and contains a custom plastic frame holding a smartphone. (4) He demonstrates how the book functions as a cover by holding it open and pretending to read while actually looking at the phone screen nestled inside the hollow pages. (5) The camera provides a close-up of the phone screen showing a social media video feed, followed by the man closing the book to show it looks completely normal from the outside. (6) He continues to hold the book and engage with the woman, gesturing towards the cover and the interior frame while maintaining a smiling facial expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A bright female voice asks what the man is holding, followed immediately by the crinkling sound of plastic bubble wrap being handled. A light, upbeat acoustic guitar BGM with a steady tempo begins. (2) The male voice responds with a cheerful and energetic tone, explaining his new purchase. The sound of the bubble wrap increases as he unwraps the object. (3) Both individuals laugh loudly as the man reveals the secret of the hollow book. The male voice becomes more exaggerated and comedic in its pitch variability. (4) The conversation continues with high speech density as they discuss the motive of hiding phone use from a child named Xingxing. The BGM remains constant in the background at a moderate volume. (5) Incidental sounds of the phone clicking into its plastic cradle and the book cover snapping shut are heard periodically. The female voice offers positive commentary on the gadget while the playful guitar track concludes the session.
